protohow.text: Try: Search (header) → type tmux, arrows, ⏎, ⇧⏎ opens in the right sidebar, / shows filters, ⌘⏎ sends the search to the sidebar. Open the AI Engineer Summit page from search → More → View as slides, then arrow keys and f. The Omer Hamerman YouTube page has {{youtube-timestamp}} links that seek the video placeholder. AI/Batch Inference shows Mermaid as a fenced code block (Logseq does not draw Mermaid without a plugin). More → Toggle theme for dark mode. Shift-click any link to open it in the right sidebar. Use Fill (top right) while playing. The left sidebar's Example pages list the heading ladder, every query state, the yazi flashcard deck, and code with Logseq's syntax colours (Rust, Python, Bash, Mermaid).
